kjv.text: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

bsb.text: And do this, understanding the occasion. The hour has come for you to wake up from your slumber, for our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.

web.text: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

flow.text: Henry shows us four things a Christian must do each day, starting with when to wake up. The time demands it.

When to awake: *Now it is high time to awake* (Ro 13:11), to awake out of the sleep of sin (for a sinful condition is a sleeping condition), out of the sleep of carnal security, sloth and negligence, out of the sleep of spiritual death, and out of the sleep of spiritual deadness; both the wise and foolish virgins slumbered and slept, Mt 25:5. We have need to be often excited and stirred up to awake.
We sleep through sin, carelessness, and spiritual deadness. Christ's command to all his followers is to watch and be alert.

"The time we are cast into: *Knowing the time.* Consider what time of day it is with us, and you will see it is high time to awake. It is gospel time, it is the accepted time, it is working time; it is a time when more is expected than was in the times of that ignorance which God winked at, when people sat in darkness. It is high time to awake; for the sun has been up a great while, and shines in our faces.
This is gospel time, a time of light and work. The sun shines on us; others are awake and busy around us.

Know the time to be a perilous time. We are in the midst of enemies and snares. It is high time to awake, for the Philistines are upon us; our neighbour's house is on fire, and our own in danger. It is time to awake, for we have slept enough (1Pe 4:3), high time indeed, for *behold the bridegroom cometh.*" 2.
We face danger and enemies. The bridegroom is coming, and we have slept long enough.

"The salvation we are upon the brink of: *Now is our salvation nearer than when we believed*—than when we first believed, and so took upon us the profession of Christianity. The eternal happiness we chose for our portion is now nearer to us than it was when we became Christians. Let us mind our way and mend our pace, for we are now nearer our journey's end than we were when we had our first love.

morning.say: Carry Henry's call into your day: the time is now, and heaven is nearer than ever.
morning.phrase: Now it is high time to awake

leads.kjv: Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.
But the end of all things is at hand: be ye therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
